meta.name: seo-strategy
meta.description: Audits and improves organic search performance — technical health, site architecture, internal linking, structured data, and the content decisions that determine what can rank. Use this to run an SEO audit, diagnose why pages are not ranking or were deindexed, plan a site's URL and navigation structure, add structured data, or prioritize which SEO fixes are worth doing.

copy.tagline: 审计网站搜索表现并规划能提升排名的优化动作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站靠搜索来客,却搞不清排名为何下滑
copy.tagline_en: Audit your website's search visibility and plan changes that boost rankings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your organic traffic is underperforming and you don't know why.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤检查你的网站为什么在搜索结果中表现不好，从搜索引擎能否找到、能否收录、内容是否匹配用户问题，到网站信誉是否足够，最后给出按轻重缓急排列的修改建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求做 SEO 审计、诊断页面不排名或未收录、规划网站结构等时，它会接管。

say.text: 对我的网站做一次 SEO 审计，按严重程度列出问题并给出建议。
say.note: 会按顺序检查抓取、索引、意图匹配、权威性。

say.text: 我网站有几个页面突然不收录了，帮我诊断原因。
say.note: 会检查索引状态和可能的重复内容等问题。

say.text: 给这个产品页加上 JSON-LD 结构化数据，标注价格和库存。
say.note: 会生成符合规范的结构化数据标记。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks why a site underperforms in search, in order: findability, indexation, content-intent match, and authority, then suggests prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: It takes over when the user asks for an SEO audit, diagnoses why pages are not ranking or were deindexed, or plans a site's URL/navigation structure.

say_en.text: Run an SEO audit on my site, list issues by severity, and give suggestions.
say_en.note: Follows the diagnostic order: crawl, index, intent, authority.

say_en.text: A few pages on my site stopped being indexed. Diagnose why.
say_en.note: Checks index status and possible duplicate content.

say_en.text: Add JSON-LD structured data to this product page with price and availability.
